skills.name: 覆载
skills.text: 锁定技，你的装备牌只能当【借刀】或【无中生有】使用。若你的装备区里没有牌，你视为装备着一张武器牌和防具牌。

skills.name: 霸朝
skills.text: 出牌阶段开始时，你可以令所有其他角色同时选择是否交给你一张牌，然后你可对未以此法交给你非基本牌的一名角色造成1点伤害，若你选择自己，本阶段你使用当前手牌无次数和距离限制并入魔。

equipment.name: 诸葛连弩
equipment.fullRule:
攻击范围：1
技能
锁定技，你使用【杀】无次数限制。

equipment.name: 青釭剑
equipment.fullRule:
攻击范围：2
技能
锁定技，当你使用【杀】指定目标后，你令其防具对此【杀】无效。

equipment.name: 贯石斧
equipment.fullRule:
攻击范围：3
技能
当你使用的【杀】被目标角色使用的【闪】抵消后，你可以弃置两张牌。若如此做，此【杀】依然会造成伤害。

equipment.name: 丈八蛇矛
equipment.fullRule:
攻击范围：3
技能
你可以将两张手牌当【杀】使用或打出。

equipment.name: 雌雄双股剑
equipment.fullRule:
攻击范围：2
技能
当你使用【杀】指定与你性别不同的目标后，你可以令其选择一项：1.弃置一张手牌；2.令你摸一张牌。

equipment.name: 青龙偃月刀
equipment.fullRule:
攻击范围：3
技能
当你使用的【杀】被目标角色使用的【闪】抵消后，你可以对其使用一张【杀】。

equipment.name: 寒冰剑
equipment.fullRule:
攻击范围：2
技能
当你使用【杀】对目标角色造成伤害时，若其有牌，你可以防止此伤害，然后你依次弃置其两张牌。

equipment.name: 麒麟弓
equipment.fullRule:
攻击范围：5
技能
当你使用【杀】对目标角色造成伤害时，你可以弃置其装备区里的一张坐骑牌。

equipment.name: 方天画戟
equipment.fullRule:
攻击范围：4
技能
锁定技，若你使用的【杀】是你最后的手牌，则此【杀】能多指定两个目标。

equipment.name: 古锭刀
equipment.fullRule:
攻击范围：2
技能
锁定技，当你使用【杀】对目标角色造成伤害时，若该角色没有手牌，则此伤害+1。

equipment.name: 朱雀羽扇
equipment.fullRule:
攻击范围：4
技能
当你使用普通【杀】时，你可以将此【杀】改为火【杀】。

equipment.name: 七宝刀
equipment.fullRule:
攻击范围：2
技能
锁定技，你使用【杀】无视目标防具，若目标角色未损失体力值，此【杀】伤害+1。

equipment.name: 百辟刀
equipment.fullRule:
攻击范围：2
技能
当你使用【杀】造成伤害后，你可以获得目标角色一张手牌。

equipment.name: 白银狮子
equipment.fullRule: 锁定技，当你受到伤害时，若伤害值大于1，将此伤害值改为1。当你失去装备区里的【白银狮子】时，你回复1点体力。

equipment.name: 藤甲
equipment.fullRule: 锁定技，【南蛮入侵】【万箭齐发】和普通【杀】对你无效。当你受到火焰伤害时，此伤害+1。

equipment.name: 仁王盾
equipment.fullRule: 锁定技，黑色【杀】对你无效。

equipment.name: 八卦阵
equipment.fullRule: 当你需要使用或打出【闪】时，你可以判定，若判定结果为红色，则你视为使用或打出一张【闪】。

engineeringDecisions.rule: The thirteen weapons and four armors are independently uniformly sampled in the current-HP matching subset: weapon range equals HP, armor canonical Chinese name length equals HP; when no match exists, that equipment class uses its full pool. Operational empirical reports motivate the formula; first-party public resources do not prove its weights.

Sample once at genuine GameStarting and each true HP-value change in native event order. Pure queries, armor-only damage and unchanged HP do not resample. Physical equipment entry suspends the issued virtual pair, and departure restores that same pair without RNG.

Virtual equipment grants the full named native weapon/armor abilities but is not a physical entity. Rerolling or losing a virtual Silver Lion does not fabricate removal recovery. Borrowed Sword still requires a real transferable weapon for holder/transfer legality.

Current Bachao3902 lets all other living roles privately commit one HE entity or decline before any gift resolves. The accepted action-order roster is frozen. Real native movement and its children settle each gift; only actual nonbasic arrival protects the giver. OutsideGame normalization is not treated as an arrival.

After all gifts, the owner may decline damage or choose an eligible living role, including self. Accepted self native Damage1 and all children finish before freezing the then-current Hand and entering existing Rumo, without requiring positive actual damage. A paid tail survives source loss; native terminal rules still apply.

The frozen Hand entity set grants distance and use-count exemptions only in that actual Play. All physical materials of a converted/multiple-material use must come from the actor’s original Hand and all belong to that issued set. Zero materials and later gained entities do not inherit the privilege; ordinary targets, prohibitions, response and payment rules remain native.

BaiBiDao is optional and uses a precise real/virtual weapon ability authorization plus original native Slash damage/window/action proof. It does not fake a Fuzai or initial skill instance. All other fifteen equipment effects reuse their existing named native mechanisms; QiBaoDao has its full armor bypass and full-HP target Slash damage bonus.
